rules.sentence: When `LK-PRODUCT` is `'GD'` (`LK-GOLD`), it sets `WS-YEARLY-RATE` to 0.1690, computes `WS-CENTS` as `LK-BALANCE * WS-YEARLY-RATE / 12 * 100`, sets `RETURN-CODE` to `WS-CENTS`, and returns to its caller.

When `LK-PRODUCT` is not `'GD'` (not `LK-GOLD`) and `LK-PRODUCT` is `'BZ'` (`LK-BUSINESS`), it sets `WS-YEARLY-RATE` to 0.1490, computes `WS-CENTS` as `LK-BALANCE * WS-YEARLY-RATE / 12 * 100`, sets `RETURN-CODE` to `WS-CENTS`, and returns to its caller.

When `LK-PRODUCT` is not `'GD'` (not `LK-GOLD`) and `LK-PRODUCT` is not `'BZ'` (not `LK-BUSINESS`), it sets `WS-YEARLY-RATE` to 0.1990, computes `WS-CENTS` as `LK-BALANCE * WS-YEARLY-RATE / 12 * 100`, sets `RETURN-CODE` to `WS-CENTS`, and returns to its caller.
